# Overview {.unnumbered}

This document contains the complete, reproducible workflow supporting the study **"One Health-based metagenomic surveillance reveals key drivers of bacterial diversity and resistome dynamics in surface waters of central Mexico"**. 

Here we provide the step-by-step data preprocessing, statistical modeling, and high-resolution visualization scripts used to analyze shotgun metagenomic data from 31 surface water samples across central Mexico, encompassing taxonomic profiling, alpha and beta diversity, antimicrobial resistance gene (ARG) curation and normalization (RPKG), and tripartite cross-domain analyses (taxonomy, resistome, and physicochemical environment).

<hr>

# Taxonomic Profiling and Relative Abundance (31 Samples)

This section processes the taxonomic matrices across six hierarchical levels (*Phylum*, *Class*, *Order*, *Family*, *Genus*, and *Species*), removes residual eukaryotic/human host sequences, generates publication-ready relative abundance barplots for dominant taxa (> 1% mean relative abundance), consolidates master abundance tables, and performs compositional statistical comparisons using Centered Log-Ratio (CLR) transformation.

## Multilevel Processing (Phylum, Class, Order, and Family)

```{r multilevel-processing, eval=FALSE}
setwd("/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/taxonomy_matrix/ABUNDANCIA_ULTIMA")

levels <- c("family", "phylum", "order", "class")

process_level <- function(level) {
  file_name <- paste0("integrated_matrix_31_", level, ".txt")
  
  if (!file.exists(file_name)) {
    message("File not found: ", file_name)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  abundance_matrix <- read.delim(file_name, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)
  colnames(abundance_matrix) <- gsub(paste0("\\.", level), "", colnames(abundance_matrix))
  
  sample_cols <- colnames(abundance_matrix)[2:ncol(abundance_matrix)]
  clean_sample_cols <- gsub(".*?([A-Za-z]+)[^1-9]*([1-9][0-9]*).*", "\\1\\2", sample_cols)
  colnames(abundance_matrix)[2:ncol(abundance_matrix)] <- clean_sample_cols
  
  human_pattern <- "Homo|Hominidae|Primates|sapiens"
  taxa_column <- colnames(abundance_matrix)[1]
  
  rows_before <- nrow(abundance_matrix)
  abundance_matrix <- abundance_matrix %>% 
    filter(!grepl("Chordata", .[, 1], ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    filter(!grepl(human_pattern, .data[[taxa_column]], ignore.case = TRUE))
  rows_after <- nrow(abundance_matrix)
  
  if ((rows_before - rows_after) > 0) {
    message("--> [", level, "] Removed ", rows_before - rows_after, " rows associated with human/eukaryotic contamination.")
  }
  
  table_abs <- as.matrix(abundance_matrix[, 2:ncol(abundance_matrix)])
  rownames(table_abs) <- abundance_matrix[, 1]
  
  if (nrow(table_abs) == 0 || sum(table_abs) == 0) {
    message("Warning: The matrix for ", level, " is empty after filtering.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  table_rel <- sweep(table_abs, 2, colSums(table_abs), FUN = "/") * 100
  
  abs_export <- as.data.frame(table_abs) %>% rownames_to_column("Sample name")
  rel_export <- as.data.frame(table_rel) %>% rownames_to_column("Sample name")
  
  write.csv(abs_export, paste0("Absolute_Abundance_31_", level, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(rel_export, paste0("Relative_Abundance_31_", level, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  message("Successfully processed: ", level)
}

for (level in levels) {
  process_level(level)
}
```

## Genus-Level Relative Abundance (> 1%) and Figure 3 Assembly

```{r genus-abundance-plots, eval=FALSE}
setwd("/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/taxonomy_matrix/ABUNDANCIA_ULTIMA")

metadatos_raw <- read_tsv("metadatos_saida_ultimos2.txt", col_names = TRUE, show_col_types = FALSE)

if (is.na(colnames(metadatos_raw)[1]) || colnames(metadatos_raw)[1] == "" || grepl("^\\s*$", colnames(metadatos_raw)[1])) {
  colnames(metadatos_raw)[1] <- "Sample"
}

colnames(metadatos_raw) <- trimws(gsub("[\"']", "", colnames(metadatos_raw)))
colnames(metadatos_raw) <- gsub(" ", "_", colnames(metadatos_raw))
colnames(metadatos_raw) <- make.names(colnames(metadatos_raw), unique = TRUE)

if (!"Sample" %in% colnames(metadatos_raw)) {
  metadatos_raw <- metadatos_raw %>% rename(Sample = 1)
}

metadatos <- as.data.frame(metadatos_raw)
metadatos$Sample <- trimws(as.character(metadatos[, "Sample"]))
metadatos$State  <- trimws(as.character(metadatos[, "State"]))
metadatos$Water_body_type <- trimws(as.character(metadatos[, "Water_body_type"]))

matrix_abund <- read.delim("integrated_matrix_31_genus.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(!grepl("Homo|Hominidae|Primates|sapiens", .[, 1], ignore.case = TRUE))

tabla <- as.matrix(matrix_abund[, 2:ncol(matrix_abund)])
rownames(tabla) <- matrix_abund[, 1] 

limpiar_nombre_matriz <- function(sample_vector) {
  sapply(sample_vector, function(s) {
    if (!grepl("_", s)) return(s)
    partes <- strsplit(s, "_")[[1]]
    lugar <- partes[1]
    num_int <- NA
    for (p in partes[2:length(partes)]) {
      val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(p))
      if (!is.na(val)) {
        num_int <- val
        break
      }
    }
    if (is.na(num_int)) num_int <- 1
    paste0(lugar, num_int)
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

colnames(tabla) <- limpiar_nombre_matriz(colnames(tabla))
tabla_rel <- sweep(tabla, 2, colSums(tabla), FUN = "/") * 100

prepare_table_greater_1 <- function(df_input) {
  mean_taxa <- rowMeans(df_input)
  taxa_names <- names(mean_taxa[mean_taxa > 1])
  
  df_temp <- as.data.frame(df_input)
  colnames(df_temp) <- make.names(colnames(df_temp), unique = TRUE)
  if ("Taxa" %in% colnames(df_temp)) colnames(df_temp)[colnames(df_temp) == "Taxa"] <- "Taxa_Orig"
  
  tabla_filtrada <- df_temp %>%
    rownames_to_column("Taxa") %>%
    filter(Taxa %in% taxa_names) %>%
    mutate(Mean_Order = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., -Taxa))) %>%
    arrange(desc(Mean_Order)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-Mean_Order)
  
  etiqueta_resto <- "Others (Abundance < 1 %)"
  matriz_num <- tabla_filtrada %>% column_to_rownames("Taxa")
  resto_val <- 100 - colSums(matriz_num)
  
  fila_resto <- as.data.frame(t(resto_val)) %>% mutate(Taxa = etiqueta_resto)
  
  melt_df <- bind_rows(tabla_filtrada, fila_resto) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Taxa, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Freq") %>%
    mutate(Taxa = factor(Taxa, levels = c(tabla_filtrada$Taxa, etiqueta_resto)))
  
  return(melt_df)
}

melt_subtable_genus <- prepare_table_greater_1(tabla_rel) %>%
  left_join(metadatos, by = "Sample", suffix = c("", ".y")) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".y"))

taxa_levels <- levels(melt_subtable_genus$Taxa)
taxa_sin_others <- setdiff(taxa_levels, "Others (Abundance < 1 %)")

italic_labels_genus <- function(taxa_vector) {
  lapply(taxa_vector, function(x) bquote(italic(.(x))))
}

paleta_base <- c("#E6194B", "#3CB44B", "#FFE119", "#4363D8", "#F58231", 
                 "#911EB4", "#46F0F0", "#F032E6", "#BCF60C", "#FABEBE", 
                 "#008080", "#E6BEFF", "#9A6324", "#FFFAC8", "#800000", 
                 "#AAFFC3", "#2F4F4F", "#000075", "#808000")

num_taxa_sin_others <- length(taxa_sin_others)
paleta_colores <- if (num_taxa_sin_others > length(paleta_base)) {
  colorRampPalette(paleta_base)(num_taxa_sin_others)
} else {
  paleta_base[1:num_taxa_sin_others]
}
names(paleta_colores) <- taxa_sin_others

if (!dir.exists("figures")) dir.create("figures")
if (!dir.exists("figures/tables")) dir.create("figures/tables")

grouping_vars <- c("State", "Water_body_type")

for (g_var in grouping_vars) {
  plot_data <- melt_subtable_genus %>%
    filter(Taxa != "Others (Abundance < 1 %)" & !is.na(!!sym(g_var))) %>%
    mutate(
      Grouping_Col = .data[[g_var]],
      Sample = factor(Sample, levels = unique(Sample[order(Grouping_Col, State, Water_body_type, Sample)]))
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Sample, y = Freq, fill = Taxa)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.9, color = "black", linewidth = 0.01) +
    facet_grid(as.formula(paste(". ~", g_var)), scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) x) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = paleta_colores, labels = italic_labels_genus(taxa_sin_others), breaks = taxa_sin_others) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 45, r = 10, b = 10, l = 35, unit = "pt"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 9.5, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "plain"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"), 
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, margin = margin(t = 5, b = 5)),
      panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box.margin = margin(t = -5, b = 0),
      legend.margin = margin(t = 15, b = 20),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
      legend.text.align = 0
    ) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Relative abundance (%)", fill = "") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 3, byrow = FALSE, override.aes = list(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2)))
  
  file_name_tiff <- paste0("figures/abund_1_percent_genus_", tolower(g_var), "_no_others.tiff")
  ggsave(file_name_tiff, plot = p, width = 15.5, height = 10, dpi = 500, compression = "lzw", device = "tiff")
}

df_abs_wide <- as.data.frame(tabla) %>% rownames_to_column("Taxa")
write.csv(df_abs_wide, "figures/tables/Absolute_Abundance_31_genus.csv", row.names = FALSE)

df_rel_wide <- as.data.frame(tabla_rel) %>% rownames_to_column("Taxa")
write.csv(df_rel_wide, "figures/tables/Relative_Abundance_31_genus.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### Assembly of Figure 3A and Figure 3B

```{r figure-3-assembly, eval=FALSE}
setwd("/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/taxonomy_matrix/ABUNDANCIA_ULTIMA/figures")

img_A_raw <- readTIFF("abund_1_percent_genus_state_no_others.tiff")
img_B_raw <- readTIFF("abund_1_percent_genus_water_body_type_no_others.tiff")

grob_A <- rasterGrob(img_A_raw, interpolate = TRUE)
grob_B <- rasterGrob(img_B_raw, interpolate = TRUE)

tema_publicacion <- theme(
  text = element_text(family = "sans"),
  plot.tag = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold", family = "sans"),
  plot.tag.position = c(0.03, 0.96),
  plot.margin = margin(t = 25, r = 5, b = 5, l = 25, unit = "pt") 
)

pA <- ggplot() + annotation_custom(grob_A, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf) + theme_void() + labs(tag = "A") + tema_publicacion
pB <- ggplot() + annotation_custom(grob_B, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf) + theme_void() + labs(tag = "B") + tema_publicacion

ggsave("Figure_3A.tiff", plot = pA, width = 15.5, height = 10, dpi = 500, compression = "lzw", device = "tiff")
ggsave("Figure_3B.tiff", plot = pB, width = 15.5, height = 10, dpi = 500, compression = "lzw", device = "tiff")
```

## Consolidation of Master Abundance Tables (All 6 Taxonomic Ranks)

```{r master-abundance-tables, eval=FALSE}
setwd("/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/taxonomy_matrix/ABUNDANCIA_ULTIMA")

format_sample_name <- function(sample_vector) {
  sapply(sample_vector, function(x) {
    m <- regmatches(x, regexec("^([A-Za-z]+).*?([0-9]+)$", x))
    if (length(m[[1]]) == 3) {
      state <- m[[1]][2]
      num <- sub("^0+", "", m[[1]][3])
      if (num == "") num <- "0"
      paste0(state, num)
    } else {
      x
    }
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

process_wide_abs <- function(file_path, level_name) {
  df <- read.csv(file_path, check.names = FALSE)
  colnames(df)[1] <- "Taxa"
  
  df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Taxa, names_to = "Sample name", values_to = "Absolute_Abundance") %>%
    mutate(
      `Sample name` = format_sample_name(`Sample name`),
      Taxonomic_Level = level_name
    ) %>%
    select(Taxonomic_Level, Taxa, `Sample name`, Absolute_Abundance)
}

master_abs_table <- bind_rows(
  process_wide_abs("Absolute_Abundance_31_phylum.csv", "Phylum"),
  process_wide_abs("Absolute_Abundance_31_class.csv", "Class"),
  process_wide_abs("Absolute_Abundance_31_order.csv", "Order"),
  process_wide_abs("Absolute_Abundance_31_family.csv", "Family"),
  process_wide_abs("Absolute_Abundance_31_genus.csv", "Genus"),
  process_wide_abs("Absolute_Abundance_31_species.csv", "Species")
)

write.csv(master_abs_table, "Master_Table_Absolute_Abundance.csv", row.names = FALSE)

process_wide_rel <- function(file_path, level_name) {
  df <- read.csv(file_path, check.names = FALSE)
  colnames(df)[1] <- "Taxa"
  
  df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Taxa, names_to = "Sample name", values_to = "Relative_Abundance") %>%
    mutate(
      `Sample name` = format_sample_name(`Sample name`),
      Taxonomic_Level = level_name
    ) %>%
    select(Taxonomic_Level, Taxa, `Sample name`, Relative_Abundance)
}

master_rel_table <- bind_rows(
  process_wide_rel("Relative_Abundance_31_phylum.csv", "Phylum"),
  process_wide_rel("Relative_Abundance_31_class.csv", "Class"),
  process_wide_rel("Relative_Abundance_31_order.csv", "Order"),
  process_wide_rel("Relative_Abundance_31_family.csv", "Family"),
  process_wide_rel("Relative_Abundance_31_genus.csv", "Genus"),
  process_wide_rel("Relative_Abundance_31_species.csv", "Species")
)

write.csv(master_rel_table, "Master_Table_Relative_Abundance.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Compositional CLR Transformation & Kruskal-Wallis Analysis (Taxa > 1%)

```{r clr-kruskal-wallis, eval=FALSE}
setwd("/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/taxonomy_matrix/ABUNDANCIA_ULTIMA")

df_genus_raw   <- read.csv("Complete_Table_Relative_Abundance_Genus.csv", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
df_species_raw <- read.csv("Complete_Table_Relative_Abundance_Species.csv", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
metadata_raw   <- read_tsv("metadatos_saida_ultimos2.txt", col_names = TRUE, show_col_types = FALSE)

metadata_stats <- as.data.frame(metadata_raw)
colnames(metadata_stats) <- trimws(gsub("[\"']", "", colnames(metadata_stats)))
if (!"Sample" %in% colnames(metadata_stats)) colnames(metadata_stats)[1] <- "Sample"

metadata_stats$Sample <- trimws(as.character(metadata_stats$Sample))
metadata_stats$State  <- trimws(as.character(metadata_stats$State))

if ("Water body type" %in% colnames(metadata_stats) && !"Water_body_type" %in% colnames(metadata_stats)) {
  metadata_stats$Water_body_type <- trimws(as.character(metadata_stats[["Water body type"]]))
} else if ("Water_body_type" %in% colnames(metadata_stats)) {
  metadata_stats$Water_body_type <- trimws(as.character(metadata_stats$Water_body_type))
}

process_long_abundance <- function(df, rank_name) {
  if ("Sample" %in% colnames(df) && !"SampleID" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df <- df %>% rename(SampleID = Sample)
  } else if ("Sample name" %in% colnames(df) && !"SampleID" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df <- df %>% rename(SampleID = `Sample name`)
  }
  
  val_col <- intersect(c("Relative_Abundance_Pct", "Relative_Abundance", "Abundance"), colnames(df))[1]
  
  df %>%
    rename(Relative_Abundance = all_of(val_col)) %>%
    mutate(Taxonomic_Rank = rank_name) %>%
    select(Taxonomic_Rank, Taxa, SampleID, Relative_Abundance)
}

df_long <- bind_rows(
  process_long_abundance(df_genus_raw, "Genus"),
  process_long_abundance(df_species_raw, "Species")
) %>%
  left_join(metadata_stats %>% select(Sample, State, Water_body_type), by = c("SampleID" = "Sample")) %>%
  rename(Taxon_Clean = Taxa)

taxa_mayores_1 <- df_long %>%
  group_by(Taxonomic_Rank, Taxon_Clean) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Relative_Abundance = mean(Relative_Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(Mean_Relative_Abundance > 1) %>%
  mutate(Nombre_Final = Taxon_Clean)

df_top_1_percent <- df_long %>%
  inner_join(taxa_mayores_1 %>% select(Taxonomic_Rank, Taxon_Clean, Nombre_Final), 
             by = c("Taxonomic_Rank", "Taxon_Clean"))

df_wide_samples <- df_top_1_percent %>%
  select(SampleID, State, Water_body_type, Nombre_Final, Relative_Abundance) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Nombre_Final, values_from = Relative_Abundance, values_fill = 0)

metadata_df <- df_wide_samples %>% select(SampleID, State, Water_body_type)
abundance_matrix <- df_wide_samples %>% select(-SampleID, -State, -Water_body_type)

pseudo_count <- 1e-5
abundance_matrix[abundance_matrix == 0] <- pseudo_count

calcular_clr <- function(matriz) {
  log_mat <- log(matriz)
  medias_log <- rowMeans(log_mat)
  sweep(log_mat, 1, medias_log, "-")
}

clr_matrix <- as.data.frame(calcular_clr(abundance_matrix))

df_clr_long <- bind_cols(metadata_df, clr_matrix) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(SampleID, State, Water_body_type), 
    names_to = "Nombre_Final", 
    values_to = "CLR_Abundance"
  )

kw_results <- df_clr_long %>%
  group_by(Nombre_Final) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value_State = kruskal.test(CLR_Abundance ~ as.factor(State))$p.value,
    p_value_WaterBody = kruskal.test(CLR_Abundance ~ as.factor(Water_body_type))$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(taxa_mayores_1 %>% select(Nombre_Final, Taxonomic_Rank), by = "Nombre_Final") %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_State = p.adjust(p_value_State, method = "fdr"),
    p_adj_WaterBody = p.adjust(p_value_WaterBody, method = "fdr"),
    P_adj_Formatted_State = ifelse(p_adj_State < 0.05, paste0(sprintf("%.3f", p_adj_State), "*"), sprintf("%.3f", p_adj_State)),
    P_adj_Formatted_WaterBody = ifelse(p_adj_WaterBody < 0.05, paste0(sprintf("%.3f", p_adj_WaterBody), "*"), sprintf("%.3f", p_adj_WaterBody))
  )

mean_state <- df_clr_long %>%
  group_by(Nombre_Final, State) %>%
  summarise(Mean_CLR = round(mean(CLR_Abundance), 2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = State, values_from = Mean_CLR, names_prefix = "State_")

mean_waterbody <- df_clr_long %>%
  group_by(Nombre_Final, Water_body_type) %>%
  summarise(Mean_CLR = round(mean(CLR_Abundance), 2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Water_body_type, values_from = Mean_CLR, names_prefix = "WBT_")

tabla_maestra <- kw_results %>%
  left_join(mean_state, by = "Nombre_Final") %>%
  left_join(mean_waterbody, by = "Nombre_Final") %>%
  select(
    Taxonomic_Rank,
    Taxa = Nombre_Final,
    `Kruskal-Wallis P-adj (State)` = P_adj_Formatted_State,
    `Mexico City` = `State_Mexico City`,
    Morelos = State_Morelos,
    `State of Mexico` = `State_State of Mexico`,
    Tlaxcala = State_Tlaxcala,
    `Kruskal-Wallis P-adj (Water body type)` = P_adj_Formatted_WaterBody,
    Lentic = WBT_Lentic,
    Lotic = WBT_Lotic
  )

tabla_generos <- tabla_maestra %>% filter(Taxonomic_Rank == "Genus") %>% select(-Taxonomic_Rank) %>% arrange(Taxa)
tabla_especies <- tabla_maestra %>% filter(Taxonomic_Rank == "Species") %>% select(-Taxonomic_Rank) %>% arrange(Taxa)

write.csv(tabla_generos, "KW_Genera_Table_Mayor1Pct_State_WBT.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
write.csv(tabla_especies, "KW_Species_Table_Mayor1Pct_State_WBT.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

# Rarefaction, Alpha, and Beta Diversity (Genus and Species Levels)

This section evaluates sequencing depth sufficiency via rarefaction curves and characterizes within-sample (alpha) and between-sample (beta) bacterial diversity across states and water body types (lentic vs. lotic) at both Genus and Species levels.

## Rarefaction Curves and Sequencing Depth Assessment

```{r rarefaction-curves, eval=FALSE}
setwd("/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/taxonomy_matrix/ABUNDANCIA_ULTIMA")

metadata <- read_tsv("metadatos_saida_ultimos.txt", show_col_types = FALSE)

config_analisis <- list(
  list(nivel = "Genus",   archivo = "Abundancia_Absoluta_31_Genus.csv"),
  list(nivel = "Species", archivo = "Abundancia_Absoluta_31_Species.csv")
)

dir_rarefaccion <- "results_Rarefaction_State_WaterType"
if (!dir.exists(dir_rarefaccion)) dir.create(dir_rarefaccion)

COMMON_DEPTH    <- 50000 
FUENTE_GRAFICOS <- "sans"

for (item in config_analisis) {
  nivel   <- item$nivel
  archivo <- item$archivo
  sep_char <- if (grepl("\\.csv$", archivo)) "," else "\t"
  
  if (!file.exists(archivo)) {
    warning(paste("File", archivo, "not found. Skipping..."))
    next
  }
  
  tabla_conteos <- read.table(archivo, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = sep_char, check.names = FALSE)
  matriz_comunidad <- round(t(tabla_conteos))
  
  if (nrow(matriz_comunidad) == 0) next
  
  rarefaccion_list <- rarecurve(matriz_comunidad, step = 100, label = FALSE)
  
  rare_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(rarefaccion_list, function(curve, idx) {
    data.frame(
      Original_Sample = rownames(matriz_comunidad)[idx], 
      Reads = attr(curve, "Subsample"), 
      Taxa = as.numeric(curve)
    )
  }) %>%
    mutate(
      Sample = trimws(gsub("\\..*", "", Original_Sample)),
      Sample_Short = ifelse(
        grepl("^[A-Za-z]+_[0-9]+", Sample),
        paste0(
          sub("^([A-Za-z]+)_.*", "\\1", Sample), 
          as.numeric(sub("^[A-Za-z]+_([0-9]+)_.*", "\\1", Sample)) 
        ),
        Sample 
      )
    ) %>%
    left_join(metadata, by = c("Sample" = "Sample"))
  
  plot_rare <- ggplot(rare_df, aes(x = Reads, y = Taxa, group = Sample_Short, color = Sample_Short)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
    facet_wrap(~ State + `Water body type`, scales = "free_x") + 
    labs(
      title = paste("Rarefaction Curves by State & Water Body Type -", nivel), 
      x = "Sequencing Depth (Reads)", 
      y = paste0("Observed Taxa (", nivel, ")"),
      color = "Sample name"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = FUENTE_GRAFICOS) + 
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),          
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7, family = FUENTE_GRAFICOS),      
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", family = FUENTE_GRAFICOS),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, family = FUENTE_GRAFICOS),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", family = FUENTE_GRAFICOS),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black", family = FUENTE_GRAFICOS),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black", family = FUENTE_GRAFICOS, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f4ebd8", color = "#333333"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8.5, family = FUENTE_GRAFICOS),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 10))
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(dir_rarefaccion, "/Rarefaction_State_WaterType_", nivel, ".tiff"), 
    plot = plot_rare, width = 9.0, height = 7.0, dpi = 500, compression = "lzw", device = "tiff"
  )
  
  tabla_resumen <- rare_df %>%
    group_by(Sample_Short, State, `Water body type`) %>%
    filter(Reads <= max(Reads)) %>% 
    summarise(
      Max_Reads = max(Reads),
      Observed_Taxa_Max = max(Taxa),
      Taxa_at_50k = if (max(Reads) >= COMMON_DEPTH) approx(Reads, Taxa, xout = COMMON_DEPTH)$y else NA,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Taxa_at_50k = round(Taxa_at_50k, 0))
  
  write.csv(tabla_resumen, paste0(dir_rarefaccion, "/Summary_State_WaterType_", nivel, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Genus-Level Alpha Diversity, Beta Diversity, and Differential Analysis

```{r genus-alpha-beta-diversity, eval=FALSE}
GRAPHICS_FONT      <- "sans"   
TITLE_FONT_SIZE    <- 12     
SUBTITLE_FONT_SIZE <- 11       
AXIS_FONT_SIZE     <- 9        
TICK_FONT_SIZE     <- 9      

base_dir <- "/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/taxonomy_matrix/DIVERSIDAD_GENERO_WILCOXON"
if (!dir.exists(base_dir)) dir.create(base_dir, recursive = TRUE)
setwd(base_dir)

dir_alpha <- file.path(base_dir, "results_Alpha2")
dir_beta  <- file.path(base_dir, "results_Beta2")
dir_multi <- file.path(base_dir, "results_Multivariate2")

if (!dir.exists(dir_alpha)) dir.create(dir_alpha, recursive = TRUE)
if (!dir.exists(dir_beta))  dir.create(dir_beta, recursive = TRUE)
if (!dir.exists(dir_multi)) dir.create(dir_multi, recursive = TRUE)

palette_water_body_type <- c("Lentic" = "#E41A1C", "Lotic" = "#8FBC8F")
palette_state           <- c("Mexico City" = "#66C2A5", "Morelos" = "#8DA0CB", "State of Mexico" = "#E6AB02", "Tlaxcala" = "#800080")

rel_abund_table <- read.csv("../ABUNDANCIA_ULTIMA/Abundancia_Relativa_31_Genus2.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
metadata_raw    <- read_tsv("../ABUNDANCIA_ULTIMA/metadatos_saida_ultimos2.txt", col_names = TRUE, show_col_types = FALSE)

metadata_stats <- as.data.frame(metadata_raw)
colnames(metadata_stats) <- trimws(gsub("[\"']", "", colnames(metadata_stats)))
if (!"Sample" %in% colnames(metadata_stats)) colnames(metadata_stats)[1] <- "Sample"

metadata_stats$Sample <- trimws(as.character(metadata_stats$Sample))
metadata_stats$State  <- trimws(as.character(metadata_stats$State))

if ("Water body type" %in% colnames(metadata_stats) && !"Water_body_type" %in% colnames(metadata_stats)) {
  metadata_stats$Water_body_type <- trimws(as.character(metadata_stats[["Water body type"]]))
} else if ("Water_body_type" %in% colnames(metadata_stats)) {
  metadata_stats$Water_body_type <- trimws(as.character(metadata_stats$Water_body_type))
}

common_samples <- intersect(metadata_stats$Sample, colnames(rel_abund_table))
metadata_stats <- metadata_stats %>% filter(Sample %in% common_samples) %>% arrange(Sample)
metadata_stats$State           <- factor(metadata_stats$State)
metadata_stats$Water_body_type <- factor(metadata_stats$Water_body_type)

variables_of_interest <- c("State", "Water_body_type")
metadata_stats <- metadata_stats %>% select(Sample, all_of(variables_of_interest))
community_matrix <- t(rel_abund_table[, metadata_stats$Sample])

sink(paste0(dir_multi, "/Consolidated_Statistical_Report_Genus_Wilcoxon.txt"))
cat("=====================================================================\n")
cat("    INFERENTIAL STATISTICS REPORT (GENUS) - WILCOXON POST-HOC        \n")
cat("=====================================================================\n\n")

alpha_div <- data.frame(
  Sample   = rownames(community_matrix),
  Shannon  = vegan::diversity(community_matrix, index = "shannon"),
  Observed = vegan::specnumber(community_matrix) 
) %>% left_join(metadata_stats, by = "Sample")

alpha_div_long <- alpha_div %>% 
  select(Sample, Shannon, Observed) %>% 
  rename(`Sample Name` = Sample) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Shannon, Observed), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value")

write.csv(alpha_div_long, paste0(dir_alpha, "/Table_Article_Alpha_Values_Genus_Long.csv"), row.names = FALSE) 
alpha_results_table <- data.frame()

for (var in variables_of_interest) {
  current_palette <- if (var == "Water_body_type") palette_water_body_type else palette_state
  if (length(levels(alpha_div[[var]])) < 2) next
  
  for (index_name in c("Shannon", "Observed")) {
    form <- as.formula(paste(index_name, "~", var))
    kw_res <- kruskal.test(form, data = alpha_div)
    
    alpha_results_table <- rbind(alpha_results_table, data.frame(Variable = var, Index = index_name, KW_p_value = kw_res$p.value))
    cat(sprintf("\n[%s - %s] Kruskal-Wallis p-value: %.5f\n", var, index_name, kw_res$p.value))
    
    if (kw_res$p.value < 0.05) {
      cat(sprintf("--- Post-hoc Wilcoxon Test (BH adjusted) for %s by %s ---\n", index_name, var))
      pw_alpha <- pairwise.wilcox.test(alpha_div[[index_name]], alpha_div[[var]], p.adjust.method = "BH", exact = FALSE)
      print(pw_alpha$p.value)
    }
    
    p_val_label <- if (kw_res$p.value < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", round(kw_res$p.value, 4))
    alpha_subtitle <- paste("Kruskal-Wallis:", p_val_label, "| Wilcoxon Post-hoc")
    
    alpha_plot <- ggplot(alpha_div, aes(x = .data[[var]], y = .data[[index_name]], fill = .data[[var]])) +
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, color = "#333333") +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8, shape = 21, color = "black") +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Alpha Diversity (", index_name, ") by ", ifelse(var == "State", "State", "Water Body Type"), "\n(Taxonomic Level: Genus)"),
        subtitle = alpha_subtitle,
        x = "", y = ifelse(index_name == "Observed", "Observed Genera", "Shannon Index")
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = AXIS_FONT_SIZE, base_family = GRAPHICS_FONT) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = TITLE_FONT_SIZE, family = GRAPHICS_FONT, hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", color = "#555555", size = SUBTITLE_FONT_SIZE, family = GRAPHICS_FONT, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = AXIS_FONT_SIZE, family = GRAPHICS_FONT),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = TICK_FONT_SIZE, family = GRAPHICS_FONT),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10, unit = "pt")
      ) +   
      scale_fill_manual(values = current_palette, drop = FALSE) 
    
    ggsave(paste0(dir_alpha, "/Figure_AlphaDiv_", index_name, "_", var, "_Genus.pdf"), plot = alpha_plot, width = 5.5, height = 5.2, device = "pdf")
    ggsave(paste0(dir_alpha, "/Figure_AlphaDiv_", index_name, "_", var, "_Genus.png"), plot = alpha_plot, width = 5.5, height = 5.2, dpi = 300)
    ggsave(paste0(dir_alpha, "/Figure_AlphaDiv_", index_name, "_", var, "_Genus.tiff"), plot = alpha_plot, width = 5.5, height = 5.2, dpi = 500, compression = "lzw")
  }
}
write.csv(alpha_results_table, paste0(dir_alpha, "/Table_Article_Alpha_Statistics_Genus_Wilcoxon.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

bray_dist <- vegdist(community_matrix, method = "bray")
bray_df   <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(bray_dist)) %>% rownames_to_column("Sample Name")
write.csv(bray_df, paste0(dir_beta, "/Table_Article_BrayCurtis_Matrix_Genus.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

upgma_hc <- hclust(bray_dist, method = "average")

pdf(file = paste0(dir_beta, "/Figure_UPGMA_BrayCurtis_Genus.pdf"), width = 10, height = 6)
plot(upgma_hc, main = "UPGMA Clustering (Bray-Curtis Distance)\n(Taxonomic Level: Genus)", xlab = "Sample name", sub = "", ylab = "Height (Bray-Curtis Distance)", cex = 0.8)
dev.off()

png(filename = paste0(dir_beta, "/Figure_UPGMA_BrayCurtis_Genus.png"), width = 10, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300)
plot(upgma_hc, main = "UPGMA Clustering (Bray-Curtis Distance)\n(Taxonomic Level: Genus)", xlab = "Sample name", sub = "", ylab = "Height (Bray-Curtis Distance)", cex = 0.8)
dev.off()

tiff(filename = paste0(dir_beta, "/Figure_UPGMA_BrayCurtis_Genus.tiff"), width = 10, height = 6, units = "in", res = 500, compression = "lzw")
plot(upgma_hc, main = "UPGMA Clustering (Bray-Curtis Distance)\n(Taxonomic Level: Genus)", xlab = "Sample name", sub = "", ylab = "Height (Bray-Curtis Distance)", cex = 0.8)
dev.off()

pcoa_calc <- cmdscale(bray_dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
pcoa_coords <- data.frame(Sample = rownames(community_matrix), PCoA1 = pcoa_calc$points[, 1], PCoA2 = pcoa_calc$points[, 2]) %>% 
  left_join(metadata_stats, by = "Sample") %>% 
  select(Sample, everything()) %>% 
  rename(`Sample Name` = Sample)

positive_eigenvalues <- pcoa_calc$eig[pcoa_calc$eig > 0]
var_explained_pc1 <- round(100 * (positive_eigenvalues[1] / sum(positive_eigenvalues)), 1)
var_explained_pc2 <- round(100 * (positive_eigenvalues[2] / sum(positive_eigenvalues)), 1)

permanova_combined <- data.frame()
permdisp_combined  <- data.frame()

for (var in variables_of_interest) {
  current_palette <- if (var == "Water_body_type") palette_water_body_type else palette_state
  if (length(levels(metadata_stats[[var]])) < 2) next
  
  formula_perm  <- as.formula(paste("bray_dist ~", var))
  permanova_res <- adonis2(formula_perm, data = metadata_stats, permutations = 999)
  
  perm_df <- as.data.frame(permanova_res) %>% rownames_to_column("Term") %>% mutate(Variable = var) %>% select(Variable, everything())
  permanova_combined <- bind_rows(permanova_combined, perm_df)
  
  perm_disp      <- betadisper(bray_dist, group = metadata_stats[[var]])
  perm_disp_pval <- permutest(perm_disp, permutations = 999)
  
  disp_df <- as.data.frame(perm_disp_pval$tab) %>% rownames_to_column("Source") %>% mutate(Variable = var) %>% select(Variable, everything())
  permdisp_combined <- bind_rows(permdisp_combined, disp_df)
  
  dynamic_r2   <- round(permanova_res$R2[1], 3) 
  p_permanova  <- permanova_res$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  perm_p_label <- if (p_permanova <= 0.001) "p <= 0.001" else paste0("p = ", round(p_permanova, 3))
  figure_subtitle <- bquote(paste("PERMANOVA: ", R^2, " = ", .(dynamic_r2), " (", .(perm_p_label), ") | PERMDISP: ", p, " = ", .(round(perm_disp_pval$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1], 3))))
  
  pcoa_plot <- ggplot(pcoa_coords, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = .data[[var]], fill = .data[[var]])) +
    stat_ellipse(geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.08, linetype = "dashed", size = 0.5, level = 0.95, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(size = 3.8, alpha = 0.85, shape = 21, stroke = 0.4, color = "black") +
    labs(
      x = paste0("PCoA1 (Bray-Curtis: ", var_explained_pc1, "%)"), 
      y = paste0("PCoA2 (Bray-Curtis: ", var_explained_pc2, "%)"), 
      title = paste0("PCoA (Bray-Curtis) by ", ifelse(var == "State", "State", "Water Body Type"), "\n(Taxonomic Level: Genus)"), 
      subtitle = figure_subtitle
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = AXIS_FONT_SIZE, base_family = GRAPHICS_FONT) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = TITLE_FONT_SIZE, hjust = 0.5), 
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = SUBTITLE_FONT_SIZE, face = "italic", hjust = 0.5), 
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10, unit = "pt")
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = current_palette, drop = FALSE) 
  
  ggsave(filename = paste0(dir_beta, "/Figure_PCoA_BrayCurtis_", var, "_Genus.pdf"), plot = pcoa_plot, width = 7.5, height = 6.0, device = "pdf")
  ggsave(filename = paste0(dir_beta, "/Figure_PCoA_BrayCurtis_", var, "_Genus.png"), plot = pcoa_plot, width = 7.5, height = 6.0, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(filename = paste0(dir_beta, "/Figure_PCoA_BrayCurtis_", var, "_Genus.tiff"), plot = pcoa_plot, width = 7.5, height = 6.0, dpi = 500, compression = "lzw")
}

write.csv(permanova_combined, paste0(dir_multi, "/Table_Article_PERMANOVA_Combined_Genus.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(permdisp_combined, paste0(dir_multi, "/Table_Article_PERMDISP_Combined_Genus.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

mean_abund_per_taxa  <- colMeans(community_matrix)
taxa_greater_1_names <- names(mean_abund_per_taxa[mean_abund_per_taxa > 1])

if (length(taxa_greater_1_names) == 0) {
  stop("ALERT: No taxon meets the > 1% abundance filter.")
}

taxa_1pct_matrix <- as.data.frame(community_matrix[, taxa_greater_1_names, drop = FALSE]) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>% 
  left_join(metadata_stats, by = "Sample") %>% 
  select(Sample, everything()) %>% 
  rename(`Sample Name` = Sample)

post_hoc_table <- data.frame()
kw_combined    <- data.frame()

for (var in variables_of_interest) {
  if (length(levels(taxa_1pct_matrix[[var]])) < 2) next
  
  adj_pvals_table <- data.frame(Genus = character(), Kw_p_val = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (genus in taxa_greater_1_names) {
    formula_kw <- as.formula(paste(paste0("`", genus, "`"), "~", var))
    kw_test    <- kruskal.test(formula_kw, data = taxa_1pct_matrix)
    adj_pvals_table <- rbind(adj_pvals_table, data.frame(Genus = genus, Kw_p_val = kw_test$p.value))
  }
  
  adj_pvals_table$Kw_p_adj <- p.adjust(adj_pvals_table$Kw_p_val, method = "BH")
  kw_df <- adj_pvals_table %>% arrange(Kw_p_adj) %>% mutate(Variable = var) %>% select(Variable, everything())
  kw_combined <- bind_rows(kw_combined, kw_df)
  
  significant_genera <- adj_pvals_table$Genus[adj_pvals_table$Kw_p_adj < 0.05]
  if (length(significant_genera) > 0) {
    for (genus in significant_genera) {
      pw_test <- pairwise.wilcox.test(taxa_1pct_matrix[[genus]], taxa_1pct_matrix[[var]], p.adjust.method = "BH", exact = FALSE)
      p_mat   <- pw_test$p.value
      
      if (!is.null(p_mat)) {
        p_vals_melt <- na.omit(reshape2::melt(p_mat))
        if (nrow(p_vals_melt) > 0) {
          p_vec <- p_vals_melt$value
          names(p_vec) <- paste0(p_vals_melt$Var1, "-", p_vals_melt$Var2)
          
          cld_letters <- NULL
          tryCatch({ cld_letters <- multcompView::multcompLetters(p_vec)$Letters }, error = function(e) {})
          
          for (k in 1:nrow(p_vals_melt)) {
            g1 <- as.character(p_vals_melt$Var1[k])
            g2 <- as.character(p_vals_melt$Var2[k])
            padj_val  <- p_vals_melt$value[k]
            letter_g1 <- if (!is.null(cld_letters) && g1 %in% names(cld_letters)) cld_letters[g1] else ""
            letter_g2 <- if (!is.null(cld_letters) && g2 %in% names(cld_letters)) cld_letters[g2] else ""
            cld_format <- if (letter_g1 != "" && letter_g2 != "") paste0(letter_g1, " / ", letter_g2) else "-"
            
            post_hoc_table <- bind_rows(post_hoc_table, data.frame(
              Taxonomic_Level     = "Genus",
              Taxon               = genus,
              Evaluation_Variable = var,
              Group_Comparison    = paste0(g1, " vs ", g2),
              P_adjusted_FDR      = padj_val,
              CLD                 = cld_format,
              stringsAsFactors    = FALSE
            ))
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

write.csv(kw_combined, paste0(dir_multi, "/Table_Article_Genus1Pct_KruskalWallis_Wilcoxon_Combined.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(post_hoc_table, paste0(dir_multi, "/Post_hoc_pairwise_Genus.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
sink()
```

```{r species-alpha-beta-diversity, eval=FALSE}
alpha_div_sp <- data.frame(

) %>% left_join(metadata_stats_sp, by = "Sample") 

alpha_div_long_sp <- alpha_div_sp %>%

for (var in variables_of_interest) { 
  current_palette <- if (var == "Water_body_type") palette_water_body_type else palette_state 
  if (length(levels(alpha_div_sp[[var]])) < 2) next 
  
  for (index_name in c("Shannon", "Observed")) {

pcoa_calc_sp   <- cmdscale(bray_dist_sp, k = 2, eig = TRUE) 
pcoa_coords_sp <- data.frame(Sample = rownames(community_matrix_sp), PCoA1 = pcoa_calc_sp$points[, 1], PCoA2 = pcoa_calc_sp$points[, 2]) %>% 
  left_join(metadata_stats_sp, by = "Sample") %>% 
  select(Sample, everything()) 

pos_eig_sp <- pcoa_calc_sp$eig[pcoa_calc_sp$eig > 0] 
var_exp_pc1_sp <- round(100 * (pos_eig_sp[1] / sum(pos_eig_sp)), 1) 
var_exp_pc2_sp <- round(100 * (pos_eig_sp[2] / sum(pos_eig_sp)), 1) 

permanova_combined_sp <- data.frame()
permdisp_combined_sp  <- data.frame()

for (var in variables_of_interest) { 
  current_palette <- if (var == "Water_body_type") palette_water_body_type else palette_state 
  if (length(levels(metadata_stats_sp[[var]])) < 2) next 
  
  formula_perm  <- as.formula(paste("bray_dist_sp ~", var)) 
  permanova_res <- adonis2(formula_perm, data = metadata_stats_sp, permutations = 999) 
  
  perm_df <- as.data.frame(permanova_res) %>% rownames_to_column("Term") %>% mutate(Variable = var) %>% select(Variable, everything())
  permanova_combined_sp <- bind_rows(permanova_combined_sp, perm_df)
  
  perm_disp      <- betadisper(bray_dist_sp, group = metadata_stats_sp[[var]]) 
  perm_disp_pval <- permutest(perm_disp, permutations = 999) 
  
  disp_df <- as.data.frame(perm_disp_pval$tab) %>% rownames_to_column("Source") %>% mutate(Variable = var) %>% select(Variable, everything())
  permdisp_combined_sp <- bind_rows(permdisp_combined_sp, disp_df)
  
  dynamic_r2   <- round(permanova_res$R2[1], 3) 
  p_permanova  <- permanova_res$`Pr(>F)`[1] 
  perm_p_label <- if (p_permanova <= 0.001) "p <= 0.001" else paste0("p = ", round(p_permanova, 3)) 
  figure_subtitle <- bquote(paste("PERMANOVA: ", R^2, " = ", .(dynamic_r2), " (", .(perm_p_label), ") | PERMDISP: ", p, " = ", .(round(perm_disp_pval$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1], 3)))) 
  
  pcoa_plot <- ggplot(pcoa_coords_sp, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = .data[[var]], fill = .data[[var]])) + 
    stat_ellipse(geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.08, linetype = "dashed", size = 0.5, level = 0.95, show.legend = FALSE) +

      title = paste0("PCoA (Bray-Curtis) by ", ifelse(var == "State", "State", "Water Body Type"), "\n(Taxonomic Level: Species)"),  
      subtitle = figure_subtitle

    theme_bw(base_size = AXIS_FONT_SIZE, base_family = GRAPHICS_FONT) + 
    theme( 
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = TITLE_FONT_SIZE, hjust = 0.5),  
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = SUBTITLE_FONT_SIZE, face = "italic", hjust = 0.5),

      plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10, unit = "pt")

    scale_fill_manual(values = current_palette, drop = FALSE)  
  
  ggsave(filename = paste0(dir_beta_sp, "/Figure_PCoA_BrayCurtis_", var, "_Species.pdf"), plot = pcoa_plot, width = 7.5, height = 6.0, device = "pdf")

  ggsave(filename = paste0(dir_beta_sp, "/Figure_PCoA_BrayCurtis_", var, "_Species.tiff"), plot = pcoa_plot, width = 7.5, height = 6.0, dpi = 500, compression = "lzw") 
} 

write.csv(permanova_combined_sp, paste0(dir_multi_sp, "/Table_Article_PERMANOVA_Combined_Species.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(permdisp_combined_sp, paste0(dir_multi_sp, "/Table_Article_PERMDISP_Combined_Species.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

mean_abund_per_taxa_sp  <- colMeans(community_matrix_sp) 
taxa_greater_1_names_sp <- names(mean_abund_per_taxa_sp[mean_abund_per_taxa_sp > 1]) 
taxa_1pct_matrix_sp     <- as.data.frame(community_matrix_sp[, taxa_greater_1_names_sp, drop = FALSE]) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>% 
  left_join(metadata_stats_sp, by = "Sample") %>% 
  select(Sample, everything()) 

post_hoc_table_sp <- data.frame() 
kw_combined_sp    <- data.frame()

for (var in variables_of_interest) { 
  if (length(levels(taxa_1pct_matrix_sp[[var]])) < 2) next 
  
  adj_pvals_table <- data.frame(Species = character(), Kw_p_val = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) 
  for (species_name in taxa_greater_1_names_sp) { 
    formula_kw <- as.formula(paste(paste0("`", species_name, "`"), "~", var)) 
    kw_test    <- kruskal.test(formula_kw, data = taxa_1pct_matrix_sp) 
    adj_pvals_table <- rbind(adj_pvals_table, data.frame(Species = species_name, Kw_p_val = kw_test$p.value)) 
  } 
  
  adj_pvals_table$Kw_p_adj <- p.adjust(adj_pvals_table$Kw_p_val, method = "BH") 
  kw_df <- adj_pvals_table %>% arrange(Kw_p_adj) %>% mutate(Variable = var) %>% select(Variable, everything())
  kw_combined_sp <- bind_rows(kw_combined_sp, kw_df)
  
  significant_species <- adj_pvals_table$Species[adj_pvals_table$Kw_p_adj < 0.05] 
  if (length(significant_species) > 0) { 
    for (species_name in significant_species) { 
      pw_test <- pairwise.wilcox.test(taxa_1pct_matrix_sp[[species_name]], taxa_1pct_matrix_sp[[var]], p.adjust.method = "BH", exact = FALSE) 
      p_mat   <- pw_test$p.value 
      
      if (!is.null(p_mat)) { 
        p_vals_melt <- na.omit(reshape2::melt(p_mat)) 
        if (nrow(p_vals_melt) > 0) { 
          p_vec <- p_vals_melt$value 
          names(p_vec) <- paste0(p_vals_melt$Var1, "-", p_vals_melt$Var2) 
          
          cld_letters <- NULL 
          tryCatch({ cld_letters <- multcompView::multcompLetters(p_vec)$Letters }, error = function(e) {}) 
          
          for (k in 1:nrow(p_vals_melt)) { 
            g1 <- as.character(p_vals_melt$Var1[k]) 
            g2 <- as.character(p_vals_melt$Var2[k]) 
            padj_val  <- p_vals_melt$value[k] 
            letter_g1 <- if (!is.null(cld_letters) && g1 %in% names(cld_letters)) cld_letters[g1] else "" 
            letter_g2 <- if (!is.null(cld_letters) && g2 %in% names(cld_letters)) cld_letters[g2] else "" 
            cld_format <- if (letter_g1 != "" && letter_g2 != "") paste0(letter_g1, " / ", letter_g2) else "-" 
            
            post_hoc_table_sp <- bind_rows(post_hoc_table_sp, data.frame( 
              Taxonomic_Level     = "Species", 
              Taxon               = species_name, 
              Evaluation_Variable = var, 
              Group_Comparison    = paste0(g1, " vs ", g2), 
              P_adjusted_FDR      = padj_val, 
              CLD                 = cld_format, 
              stringsAsFactors    = FALSE 
            )) 
          } 
        } 
      } 
    } 
  } 
} 

write.csv(kw_combined_sp, paste0(dir_multi_sp, "/Table_Article_Species1Pct_KruskalWallis_Wilcoxon_Combined.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(post_hoc_table_sp, paste0(dir_multi_sp, "/Post_hoc_pairwise_Species.csv"), row.names = FALSE) 
sink()
```

# Resistome Curation, Deduplication, and RPKG Normalization

This section documents the complete bioinformatic curation of antimicrobial resistance genes (ARGs) detected across four reference databases (`CARD`, `ResFinder`, `ARG-ANNOT`, and `MEGARes`), including nomenclature standardization, removal of intrinsic housekeeping genes, coordinate-based deduplication across contigs, RPKG normalization, and hierarchical visualization of the top 50 AMR determinants.

## Multi-Database Integration (ABRicate Raw Outputs)

```{r resistome-step0-merge, eval=FALSE}
path_base <- "/Scratch/ssprado/MG_aguas_superficiales/"
path_out  <- "/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/ABRICATE/depuracion_ram_final/1_Unión_y_unificación_nombres"
dir.create(path_out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

bases_seleccionadas <- "card|resfinder|argannot|megares" 
patron_busqueda     <- paste0("out\\.(", bases_seleccionadas, ")\\.tab$")

archivos_crudos <- list.files(
  path       = path_base, 
  pattern    = patron_busqueda, 
  recursive  = TRUE, 
  full.names = TRUE
)

leer_y_etiquetar <- function(archivo) {
  df <- read_delim(archivo, delim = "\t", col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), show_col_types = FALSE)
  nombre_muestra <- basename(dirname(dirname(dirname(archivo))))
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    df <- tibble(Sample = nombre_muestra, GENE = "NO_DETECTION")
  } else {
    df <- df %>% mutate(Sample = nombre_muestra)
  }
  
  df %>% mutate(Database_Source = basename(archivo))
}

write_csv(data_maestra, file.path(path_out, "00_Consolidado_Maestro_Filtrado.csv"))
```

## Nomenclature Standardization and Intrinsic Gene Filtering (Steps 1 & 1.5)

```{r resistome-step1-audit, eval=FALSE}
path_in    <- "/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/ABRICATE/depuracion_ram_final/1_Unión_y_unificación_nombres/00_Consolidado_Maestro_Filtrado.csv"

all_raw    <- read_csv(path_in, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% clean_names()

df_auditado <- all_raw %>%
  mutate(
    gene_unif = gene %>% 
      str_to_lower() %>%
      str_remove_all("^\\((bla|phe|agly|tet|sul|dfr|mdr|quin|gly|mls|ami|ant|trim|fos|oxa|mup|rif|col|pol|cat|aminoglycoside|macrolide|lincosamide|efflux|regul|resist)\\)") %>% 
      str_remove_all("aro:[0-9]+-|gb\\|.*?\\||ref\\|.*?\\||\\|") %>%
      str_replace_all("_", "-") %>% 
      str_remove_all("^[-]+|[-]+$|(?i)(escherichia|coli|lactobacillus|reuteri|campylobacter|ecoli)") %>%
      str_replace_all("(?i)\\s*d\\s*prime", "dprime") %>% 
      str_replace_all("(?i)\\s*prime", "prime") %>%
      str_trim(),
    
    gene_unif = case_when(
      gene_unif == "aadb" ~ "ant(2'')-Ia",
      gene_unif == "aadd" ~ "ant(4')-Ib",
      gene_unif == "msrd" ~ "mel",
      gene_unif == "ble"  ~ "ble",
      gene_unif == "tetu" ~ "tet(U)",
      
      grepl("[0-9]+dprime", gene_unif) ~ paste0("(", str_extract(gene_unif, "[0-9]+"), "'')"),
      grepl("[0-9]+prime", gene_unif)  ~ paste0("(", str_extract(gene_unif, "[0-9]+"), "')"),
      
      grepl("aac-6-ib-cr|aac6'-ib-cr", gene_unif)   ~ "aac(6')-Ib-cr",
      grepl("aac-6-ib|aac6'-ib", gene_unif)         ~ "aac(6')-Ib",
      grepl("aph-3''-ib|stra|orfh", gene_unif)      ~ "aph(3'')-Ib",
      grepl("aph-6-id|strb|orficard", gene_unif)    ~ "aph(6)-Id",
      grepl("aad-?a1|str-1|^str$|^aad$", gene_unif) ~ "aadA1",
      
      grepl("^(bla)?(oxa|ctx|tem|shv|cfx|ges|mox|tla|veb|cpha|act|aer|per|lcr|kpc|fox|imi|john|lhk|nps|ceph|cmy|amps|nmca|i|bro|amph|carb)", gene_unif) ~ {
        familia <- str_to_upper(str_extract(str_remove(gene_unif, "^bla"), "^[a-z]+"))
        subtipo <- str_extract(gene_unif, "[0-9]+([-.][0-9a-z]+)?")
        ifelse(is.na(subtipo), paste0("bla", familia), paste0("bla", familia, "-", subtipo))
      },
      
      grepl("^tet-?([a-z0-9]+)", gene_unif) ~ {
        letra <- str_extract(gene_unif, "(?<=tet-?)[a-z0-9]+") %>% str_to_upper()
        paste0("tet(", letra, ")")
      },
      TRUE ~ str_to_upper(gene_unif)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!grepl("(?i)(gyra|gyrb|parc|pare|pmra|pmrb|pmrc|mura|murb|murc|murd|mure|murf|murg|ftsi|pbp|blaec|yoji|yogi|cbla|fosa|mdf|h-ns|hns|gad|emr|acr|mdt|tolc|mar|sox|msba|ugd|pmrf|epta|catp|baer|baes|aci|rob|cpx|evg|kdpe|crp|asma|bcr|baca|qcg|sat|myra|ampc|lptd|folp|rpo|glp|gln|dapa|bac|soxs|marr|gadx|gadw|pur|met|pyr|ilv|leu|arg|rpsl|uhpt|pita|glps|dapf|cys|his|fab|trx|atp|lys|thr|pro|gua|tyr|phe|ade|deo|rse|uvr|mut|dna|top|lig|rec|xer|ung|ccp|omp|etk|cps|rcs|arc|opp|pot|pst|liv|pro|mal|lam|btu|fec|fhu|ton|cir|fep|fiu|exb|exd|tol|pal|min|fts|env|lpp|msb|lpt|mrc|pon|dac|rlp|bold|slp|nlp|waac|ompf|ompt|rosa|rosb|blt|kdpe|nfsa|nfsb|fabg|fabi|kdea|estd|spc|phor)", gene_unif)) %>%
  mutate(class = case_when(
    grepl("^bla", gene_unif)                     ~ "Beta-lactams (Acquired)",
    grepl("^aph|^aac|^aad|^str|^ant", gene_unif) ~ "Aminoglycosides",
    grepl("^tet", gene_unif)                     ~ "Tetracyclines",
    grepl("^erm|^mph|^ere|^lnu|^mef", gene_unif) ~ "MLS/Oxazolidinones",
    grepl("^cat|^flo", gene_unif)                ~ "Phenicols",
    TRUE                                         ~ "Other Mobile"
  ))

write_csv(df_auditado, path_final)

path_in_15    <- "/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/ABRICATE/depuracion_ram_final/tablas_control/01_TABLA_FINAL_Q1_LIMPIA.csv"

      grepl("APH-6-ID|STRB|ORFICARD", gene_audit) ~ "aph(6)-Id",
      TRUE ~ gene_audit
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!grepl("(?i)(gyra|parc|mura|ftsi|pbp|blaec|yoji|yogi|mdt|acr|tolc|gad|mar|sox|uhpt|pita|glps|rpsl|folp|rpo|met|his|arg|lys|thr|pro|gua|tyr|phe|ade|deo|rse|uvr|mut|dna|top|lig|rec|xer|ung|ccp|omp|etk|cps|rcs|arc|opp|pot|pst|liv|pro|mal|lam|btu|fec|fhu|ton|cir|fep|fiu|exb|exd|tol|pal|min|fts|env|lpp|msb|lpt|mrc|pon|dac|rlp|bold|slp|nlp|waac|ompf|ompt|rosa|rosb|blt|nfsa|nfsb|fabg|fabi|kdea|estd|spc|phor|fab)", gene_audit)) %>%
  group_by(gene_audit, class) %>%
```

```{r resistome-step16-17, eval=FALSE}
df_17 <- df_16 %>%

    gene_final = str_remove_all(gene_audit, "^-+"),
    gene_final = str_remove_all(gene_final, "-FROM---K-12"),
    gene_final = str_replace_all(gene_final, "(?i)(aac|ant|aph)([0-9]+)\\s*d\\s*prime", "\\1(\\2'')"),
    gene_final = str_replace_all(gene_final, "(?i)(aac|ant|aph)([0-9]+)\\s*prime", "\\1(\\2')")
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    gene_final = {
      if (str_detect(gene_final, "aac|ant|aph")) {
        str_replace_all(gene_final, "-([a-z]+)", function(m) {
          parte <- str_remove(m, "-")
          parte_clean <- str_replace_all(parte, "(?i)i", "I") %>%
            str_replace_all("(?i)v", "V") %>%
            str_replace_all("[aeou]", str_to_lower)
          paste0("-", parte_clean)
        })
      } else {
        gene_final
      }
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    gene_final = case_when(
      grepl("(?i)^bla", gene_final) ~ {
        nombre <- str_remove_all(gene_final, "-") %>% str_remove("(?i)bla") %>% str_to_upper()
        paste0("bla", nombre)
      },
      grepl("(?i)^tet", gene_final) ~ {
        resto <- str_remove(gene_final, "(?i)tet") %>% str_to_upper()
        paste0("tet", resto)
      },
      TRUE ~ gene_final
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_final, class) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
```

## Coordinate-Based Contig Deduplication (> 50% Overlap Clustering)

```{python resistome-step2-deduplication, eval=FALSE}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df_original = pd.read_csv('01.8_TABLA1_+_TABLA1.7.1_+_EDICION_MANUAL_+.csv')
df_clean    = df_original.dropna(subset=['sequence', 'start', 'end']).copy()
df_clean.sort_values(['sample', 'sequence', 'start'], inplace=True)

def is_overlapping(s1, e1, s2, e2):
    overlap_start = max(s1, s2)
    overlap_end   = min(e1, e2)
    overlap_len   = max(0, overlap_end - overlap_start)
    len1 = e1 - s1
    len2 = e2 - s2
    if len1 == 0 or len2 == 0:
        return False
    return (overlap_len / len1 > 0.5) or (overlap_len / len2 > 0.5)

clusters   = []
cluster_id = 0

for (samp, seq), group in df_clean.groupby(['sample', 'sequence']):
    group = group.sort_values('start').reset_index(drop=False)
    current_clusters = []
    
    for _, row in group.iterrows():
        idx  = row['index']
        s, e = row['start'], row['end']
        placed = False
        for c in current_clusters:
            if any(is_overlapping(s, e, group.loc[group['index'] == c_idx, 'start'].values[0],
                                        group.loc[group['index'] == c_idx, 'end'].values[0]) for c_idx in c):
                c.append(idx)
                placed = True
                break
        if not placed:
            current_clusters.append([idx])
            
    for c in current_clusters:
        for idx in c:
            clusters.append({'index': idx, 'cluster_id': cluster_id})
        cluster_id += 1

cluster_df = pd.DataFrame(clusters)
df_clean   = df_clean.merge(cluster_df, left_index=True, right_on='index')
df_clean['copies_in_sample'] = df_clean.groupby(['sample', 'database_source', 'gene_unif_updated_+_manual'])['index'].transform('count')

def select_best_annotation(group):
    if len(group) == 1:
        return group.iloc[0]
    return group.sort_values(
        by=['copies_in_sample', 'percent_identity', 'percent_coverage'],
        ascending=[False, False, False]
    ).iloc[0]

df_filtered = df_clean.groupby('cluster_id').apply(select_best_annotation).reset_index(drop=True)
df_filtered.drop(columns=['index', 'cluster_id', 'copies_in_sample'], inplace=True, errors='ignore')

missing  = df_original[df_original[['sequence', 'start', 'end']].isnull().any(axis=1)].copy()
df_final = pd.concat([df_filtered, missing], ignore_index=True)
df_final.to_csv('02_FILTRADO_GENES_COPIAS_FINAL.csv', index=False)
```

## RPKG Normalization and Antimicrobial Class Refinement

$$\text{RPKG} = \frac{\text{Contig Coverage} \times 1000}{\text{Average Read Length (bp)} \times \text{Total Sequenced Gigabases (Gb)}}$$

```{r resistome-step3-rpkg, eval=FALSE}
dir_genes <- "/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/ABRICATE/depuracion_ram_final/2_Deduplicación/"
dir_stats <- "/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/ABRICATE/depuracion_ram_final/3_RPKG/RPKG_datos_BOWTIE2/"

df_genes <- read_csv(paste0(dir_genes, "02_FILTRADO_GENES_COPIAS_FINAL.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
df_stats <- read_tsv(paste0(dir_stats, "tabla_basic_stats_MoG.txt"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(Sample, Total_bases, Long_promedio)

stats_processed <- df_stats %>%
  mutate(sample_base = str_remove(Sample, "_R[12]\\.fastq$")) %>%
  group_by(sample_base) %>%
  summarise(
    total_bases_sample = sum(Total_bases),
    avg_read_length    = mean(Long_promedio),
    .groups            = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(total_gb = total_bases_sample / 1e9)

df_clean <- df_genes %>%
  filter(!is.na(sequence) & sequence != "NO_DETECTION") %>%
  mutate(contig_coverage = as.numeric(str_extract(sequence, "(?<=cov_)[0-9.]+"))) %>%
  replace_na(list(contig_coverage = 0))

df_final <- df_clean %>%
  left_join(stats_processed, by = c("sample" = "sample_base")) %>%
  mutate(RPKG = (contig_coverage * 1000) / (avg_read_length * total_gb))

write_csv(df_final, paste0(dir_stats, "RPKG_Abundance_Detailed.csv"))

abundance_by_class <- df_final %>%
  group_by(sample, class) %>%
  summarise(total_RPKG = sum(RPKG, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = class, values_from = total_RPKG, values_fill = 0)
write_csv(abundance_by_class, paste0(dir_stats, "RPKG_Abundance_by_Class.csv"))

abundance_by_gene <- df_final %>%
  group_by(sample, `gene_unif_updated_+_manual`) %>%
  summarise(total_RPKG = sum(RPKG, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = `gene_unif_updated_+_manual`, values_from = total_RPKG, values_fill = 0)
write_csv(abundance_by_gene, paste0(dir_stats, "RPKG_Abundance_by_Gene.csv"))

setwd(dir_stats)
df_completo <- df_final %>%
  mutate(
    gene_temp  = `gene_unif_updated_+_manual`,
    gene_lower = tolower(gene_temp), 
    prod_lower = tolower(product),
    refined_class = case_when(
      grepl("bla|meca|cph", gene_lower) | grepl("betalactam|beta-lactamase|carbapenem|mbl", prod_lower) ~ "Beta-lactamase",
      grepl("efflux|pump|acr|mex|mac|qac|mext|mtra|oqx|rama", prod_lower) | grepl("qac|mext|mtra|mex|oqx|rama", gene_lower) ~ "Efflux Pump / Biocide Resistance",
      grepl("tet", gene_lower) | grepl("tetracycline", prod_lower) ~ "Tetracycline Resistance",
      grepl("dfr", gene_lower) | grepl("tmt|trimethoprim|dihydrofolate", prod_lower) ~ "Trimethoprim Resistance",
      grepl("sul", gene_lower) | grepl("sulfonamide", prod_lower) ~ "Sulfonamide Resistance",
      grepl("qnr", gene_lower) | grepl("flq|quinolone|fluoroquinolone", prod_lower) ~ "Fluoroquinolone Resistance",
      grepl("mls|macrolide|lincosamide|streptogramin", prod_lower) | grepl("lnu|erm|mph|mef|msr|lsa|ere", gene_lower) ~ "Macrolide/Lincosamide/Streptogramin Resistance",
      grepl("agly|aminoglycoside", prod_lower) | grepl("^aad|^aph|^ant|str[ab]|rmt", gene_lower) ~ "Aminoglycoside Resistance",
      grepl("phe|phenicol", prod_lower) | grepl("flo|cmx|fexa|cat|cml", gene_lower) ~ "Phenicol Resistance",
      grepl("rif|rifampin|rifamycin", prod_lower) | grepl("arr|rbp", gene_lower) ~ "Rifamycin Resistance",
      grepl("mcr", gene_lower) | grepl("colistin|polymyxin", prod_lower) ~ "Polymyxin Resistance",
      grepl("van|ble", gene_lower) | grepl("glycopeptide", prod_lower) ~ "Glycopeptide Resistance",
      grepl("fos", gene_lower) | grepl("fosfomycin", prod_lower) ~ "Fosfomycin Resistance",
      grepl("iles", gene_lower) | grepl("mupirocin", prod_lower) ~ "Mupirocin Resistance",
      grepl("optra", gene_lower) | grepl("oxazolidinone|oxzln", prod_lower) ~ "Oxazolidinone Resistance",
      TRUE ~ "Other/General Resistance"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-gene_temp, -gene_lower, -prod_lower)

write.csv(df_completo, "RPKG_Abundance_Corrected_Total.csv", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

## Top 50 AMR Determinants: Statistical Summary and Hierarchical Heatmap

```{r resistome-top50-heatmap, eval=FALSE}
setwd("/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/ABRICATE/depuracion_ram_final/3_RPKG/RPKG_datos_BOWTIE2/RESISTOMA_31")

df_wide     <- read.csv("RPKG_Abundance_Estricto.csv", check.names = FALSE)
col_muestra <- colnames(df_wide)[1]
df_wide[[col_muestra]] <- gsub("^([A-Z]+)_0?(\\d+)_.*", "\\1\\2", df_wide[[col_muestra]])

mat_gene_raw <- df_wide %>% column_to_rownames(var = col_muestra) %>% as.matrix()

top_50_completa <- df_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -all_of(col_muestra), names_to = "gene", values_to = "RPKG") %>%
  rename(sample = all_of(col_muestra)) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_RPKG                     = sum(RPKG, na.rm = TRUE),
    Abundancia_Relativa_Porcentaje = (sum(RPKG, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(df_wide[, -1], na.rm = TRUE)) * 100,
    Muestras_Positivas             = n_distinct(sample[RPKG > 0]),
    Prevalencia_Porcentaje         = (n_distinct(sample[RPKG > 0]) / nrow(df_wide)) * 100,
    .groups                        = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_RPKG)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 50) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3)))

write.csv(top_50_completa, "Supplementary_Table_Top_50_Genes_Q12.csv", row.names = FALSE)

top_50_nombres <- top_50_completa$gene
mat_final      <- t(mat_gene_raw[, top_50_nombres])

df_clases <- data.frame(gene = rownames(mat_final)) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_lower = tolower(gene),
    refined_class = case_when(
      grepl("bla|meca|cph", gene_lower)                ~ "Beta-lactamase",
      grepl("qac|mext|mtra|mex|oqx|rama", gene_lower)  ~ "Efflux Pump / Biocide Resistance",
      grepl("tet", gene_lower)                         ~ "Tetracycline Resistance",
      grepl("aph|aac|ant|aad", gene_lower)             ~ "Aminoglycoside Resistance",
      grepl("qnr|gyr|par", gene_lower)                 ~ "Fluoroquinolone Resistance",
      grepl("erm|mef|mph|msr|lnu|vga|ere", gene_lower) ~ "Macrolide/Lincosamide",
      grepl("sul|dfr", gene_lower)                     ~ "Folate Pathway Antagonist",
      grepl("cat|flo|cml", gene_lower)                 ~ "Phenicol Resistance",
      TRUE                                             ~ "Other AMR Categories"
    )
  )

orden_clases <- data.frame(gene = rownames(mat_final), abundancia = rowSums(mat_final)) %>%
  left_join(df_clases, by = "gene") %>%
  group_by(refined_class) %>%
  summarise(total_class = sum(abundancia)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_class)) %>%
  pull(refined_class)

df_clases$refined_class <- factor(df_clases$refined_class, levels = orden_clases)

colores_nueva_paleta <- c("#E6194B", "#3CB44B", "#4363D8", "#911EB4", "#46F0F0", 
                          "#F032E6", "#008080", "#B6E861", "#000080", "#8B008B", 
                          "#800000", "#AAFFC3", "#808000", "#000075", "#808080", "#FF0000")

colores_clases <- setNames(colores_nueva_paleta[1:length(orden_clases)], orden_clases)
col_rpkg       <- colorRamp2(c(0, 10, 100), c("white", "gold", "firebrick"))

ha_right <- rowAnnotation(
  Class = df_clases$refined_class, 
  col   = list(Class = colores_clases),
  annotation_legend_param = list(Class = list(title = "Gene Class", title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")))
)

p_gene <- Heatmap(
  mat_final, 
  name               = "RPKG", 
  column_title       = "Top 50 AMR Determinants (Abundance Profile)",
  column_title_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "sans"),
  border             = TRUE, 
  rect_gp            = gpar(col = "gray90", lwd = 0.5),
  show_row_dend      = TRUE, 
  row_dend_gp        = gpar(lty = 1, col = "black", lwd = 1), 
  row_split          = df_clases$refined_class,
  row_title_rot      = 0,
  row_title_gp       = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "sans"),
  right_annotation   = ha_right,
  row_names_gp       = gpar(fontface = "italic", fontfamily = "sans", fontsize = 10),
  column_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontfamily = "sans"),
  col                = col_rpkg,
  cluster_rows       = TRUE, 
  cluster_columns    = TRUE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE 
)

ancho <- 16; alto <- 12

pdf("Heatmap_Genes_Final_Q12.pdf", width = ancho, height = alto)
draw(p_gene); invisible(dev.off())

png("Heatmap_Genes_Final_Q12.png", width = ancho, height = alto, units = "in", res = 600)
draw(p_gene); invisible(dev.off())

tiff("Heatmap_Genes_Final_Q12.tiff", width = ancho, height = alto, units = "in", res = 500, compression = "lzw")
draw(p_gene); invisible(dev.off())
```

# Resistome Multivariate Structure

This section evaluates the multivariate composition and structural variance of the resistome across aquatic environments using Bray-Curtis distances, PCoA ordinations, PERMANOVA, and homogeneity of multivariate dispersions (PERMDISP).

## Multivariate Analysis of Resistome Composition

```{r resistome-multivariate, eval=FALSE}
setwd("/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/multivariado resistoma_source_wbt")
dir_out <- "results_Resistome_Multivariate"
if (!dir.exists(dir_out)) dir.create(dir_out)

wbt_colors <- c("Lentic" = "#E8685D", "Lotic" = "#86C186")
state_colors <- c("Mexico City" = "#8BCEBA", "Morelos" = "#A5B6D9", "State of Mexico" = "#EFC24A", "Tlaxcala" = "#9D559E")
source_colors <- c("Canal" = "#4575B4", "River" = "#FDAE61", "Pond" = "#91CF60", "Dam" = "#762A83")

res_table <- read.csv("RPKG_Abundance_Estricto.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
metadata  <- read_tsv("metadatos_saida_ultimos.txt", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% as.data.frame()

if ("Sample" %in% colnames(metadata)) {
  metadata <- metadata %>% rename(`Sample name` = Sample)
} else if (!"Sample name" %in% colnames(metadata)) {
  colnames(metadata)[1] <- "Sample name"
}

common_samples <- intersect(rownames(res_table), metadata$`Sample name`)
res_matrix <- as.matrix(res_table[common_samples, ])
clean_meta <- metadata %>% filter(`Sample name` %in% common_samples) %>% arrange(`Sample name`)

clean_meta$`Water body type` <- factor(clean_meta$`Water body type`, levels = c("Lentic", "Lotic"))
clean_meta$State <- factor(clean_meta$State, levels = c("Mexico City", "Morelos", "State of Mexico", "Tlaxcala"))
if ("Source" %in% colnames(clean_meta)) {
  clean_meta$Source <- factor(clean_meta$Source, levels = c("Canal", "River", "Pond", "Dam"))
}

dist_res <- vegdist(res_matrix, method = "bray")

set.seed(123)
perm_wbt   <- adonis2(dist_res ~ `Water body type`, data = clean_meta, permutations = 999)
disp_wbt   <- permutest(betadisper(dist_res, clean_meta$`Water body type`), permutations = 999)

set.seed(123)
perm_state <- adonis2(dist_res ~ State, data = clean_meta, permutations = 999)
disp_state <- permutest(betadisper(dist_res, clean_meta$State), permutations = 999)

if ("Source" %in% colnames(clean_meta)) {
  set.seed(123)
  perm_source <- adonis2(dist_res ~ Source, data = clean_meta, permutations = 999)
  disp_source <- permutest(betadisper(dist_res, clean_meta$Source), permutations = 999)
}

pcoa_res <- cmdscale(dist_res, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
var_exp  <- round(pcoa_res$eig / sum(pcoa_res$eig) * 100, 1)

df_pcoa <- data.frame(
  `Sample name` = rownames(res_matrix),
  PCoA1 = pcoa_res$points[, 1],
  PCoA2 = pcoa_res$points[, 2],
  check.names = FALSE
) %>% left_join(clean_meta, by = "Sample name")

theme_q1 <- theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray30"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

plot_wbt <- ggplot(df_pcoa, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(color = `Water body type`, fill = `Water body type`), type = "norm", geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.15, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = `Water body type`), shape = 21, size = 3.5, color = "black", stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = wbt_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = wbt_colors) +
  theme_q1 +
  labs(
    title = "Resistome Composition by Water Body Type",
    subtitle = sprintf("PERMANOVA: R² = %.3f (p = %.3f) | PERMDISP: p = %.3f", perm_wbt$R2[1], perm_wbt$`Pr(>F)`[1], disp_wbt$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]),
    x = sprintf("PCoA1 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[1]),
    y = sprintf("PCoA2 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[2])
  )
ggsave(paste0(dir_out, "/Figure_Composition_PCoA_WaterBody.tiff"), plot = plot_wbt, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 500, compression = "lzw")

plot_state <- ggplot(df_pcoa, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(color = State, fill = State), type = "norm", geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.15, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = State), shape = 21, size = 3.5, color = "black", stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = state_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = state_colors) +
  theme_q1 +
  labs(
    title = "Resistome Composition by State",
    subtitle = sprintf("PERMANOVA: R² = %.3f (p = %.3f) | PERMDISP: p = %.3f", perm_state$R2[1], perm_state$`Pr(>F)`[1], disp_state$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]),
    x = sprintf("PCoA1 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[1]),
    y = sprintf("PCoA2 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[2])
  )
ggsave(paste0(dir_out, "/Figure_Composition_PCoA_State.tiff"), plot = plot_state, width = 8.5, height = 6, dpi = 500, compression = "lzw")

if ("Source" %in% colnames(clean_meta)) {
  plot_source <- ggplot(df_pcoa, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2)) +
    stat_ellipse(aes(color = Source, fill = Source), type = "norm", geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.15, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = Source), shape = 21, size = 3.5, color = "black", stroke = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = source_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = source_colors) +
    theme_q1 +
    labs(
      title = "Resistome Composition by Source",
      subtitle = sprintf("PERMANOVA: R² = %.3f (p = %.3f) | PERMDISP: p = %.3f", perm_source$R2[1], perm_source$`Pr(>F)`[1], disp_source$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]),
      x = sprintf("PCoA1 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[1]),
      y = sprintf("PCoA2 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[2])
    )
  ggsave(paste0(dir_out, "/Figure_Composition_PCoA_Source.tiff"), plot = plot_source, width = 8.5, height = 6, dpi = 500, compression = "lzw")
}
```
