# Tripartite Cross-Analysis and Co-occurrence Networks (Genus & Species vs. Resistome vs. Environment)

This section evaluates the coupling between taxonomic composition (Genus and Species levels) and resistome dynamics while controlling for environmental physicochemical parameters ($pH$, temperature, and turbidity) through Partial Mantel tests, tripartite Procrustes analyses with environmental vector fitting (`envfit`), and Spearman co-occurrence heatmaps with FDR correction.

## Genus-Level Cross-Analysis and Co-occurrence Heatmap

```{r genus-cross-analysis, eval=FALSE}
setwd("/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/RESISTOMAvsABUNDANCIAvsAMBIENTE/GENUS/31_MUESTRAS")
dir_cross <- "results_CrossAnalysis"
if (!dir.exists(dir_cross)) dir.create(dir_cross)

metadatos_stats <- read_tsv("metadatos_saida_ultimos.txt", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% as.data.frame()
if (!"Sample" %in% colnames(metadatos_stats)) colnames(metadatos_stats)[1] <- "Sample"
variables_continuas <- c("pH", "Temperature", "Turbidity")
metadatos_stats[variables_continuas] <- lapply(metadatos_stats[variables_continuas], as.numeric)

tabla_genus <- read.csv("Abundancia_Relativa_31_Genus.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
tabla_res   <- read.csv("RPKG_Abundance_Estricto.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

muestras_genus_res <- intersect(colnames(tabla_genus), rownames(tabla_res))
muestras_comunes   <- sort(intersect(muestras_genus_res, metadatos_stats$Sample))

matriz_genus <- as.matrix(t(tabla_genus[, muestras_comunes]))
matriz_res   <- as.matrix(tabla_res[muestras_comunes, ])
meta_limpio  <- metadatos_stats %>% filter(Sample %in% muestras_comunes) %>% arrange(Sample) %>% rename(`Sample name` = Sample)

dist_genus <- vegdist(matriz_genus, method = "bray")
dist_res   <- vegdist(matriz_res, method = "bray")
dist_env   <- vegdist(scale(meta_limpio %>% select(any_of(variables_continuas))), method = "euclidean")

set.seed(123)
mantel_simple  <- mantel(dist_genus, dist_res, method = "spearman", permutations = 999)
set.seed(123)
mantel_parcial <- mantel.partial(dist_genus, dist_res, dist_env, method = "spearman", permutations = 999)

pcoa_genus <- cmdscale(dist_genus, k = 2)
pcoa_res   <- cmdscale(dist_res, k = 2)

set.seed(123)
procrustes_res <- protest(X = pcoa_genus, Y = pcoa_res, permutations = 999)

set.seed(123)
envfit_cross <- envfit(pcoa_genus, meta_limpio %>% select(any_of(variables_continuas)), permutations = 999, na.rm = TRUE)
df_vectores  <- as.data.frame(envfit_cross$vectors$arrows) %>% cbind(p_val = envfit_cross$vectors$pvals) %>% rownames_to_column("Variable") %>% filter(p_val < 0.05)

pro_data <- data.frame(
  `Sample name` = rownames(matriz_genus),
  Genus_Dim1 = procrustes_res$X[, 1], Genus_Dim2 = procrustes_res$X[, 2],
  Res_Dim1 = procrustes_res$Yrot[, 1], Res_Dim2 = procrustes_res$Yrot[, 2],
  check.names = FALSE
) %>% left_join(meta_limpio, by = "Sample name")

escala <- 0.35 
plot_procrustes <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = pro_data, aes(x = Genus_Dim1, y = Genus_Dim2, xend = Res_Dim1, yend = Res_Dim2), color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = pro_data, aes(x = Genus_Dim1, y = Genus_Dim2, fill = "Genus"), shape = 21, size = 3) +
  geom_point(data = pro_data, aes(x = Res_Dim1, y = Res_Dim2, fill = "Resistome"), shape = 21, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Genus" = "#2166AC", "Resistome" = "#B2182B"), name = "Matrix") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Tripartite Procrustes: Genera, Resistome & Environment",
    subtitle = sprintf("Procrustes Corr = %.3f | Partial Mantel r = %.3f", procrustes_res$t0, mantel_parcial$statistic),
    x = "Dimension 1", y = "Dimension 2"
  )

if (nrow(df_vectores) > 0) {
  plot_procrustes <- plot_procrustes +
    geom_segment(data = df_vectores, aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = Dim1 * escala, yend = Dim2 * escala), arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), color = "forestgreen", linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = df_vectores, aes(x = Dim1 * escala, y = Dim2 * escala, label = Variable), color = "forestgreen", fontface = "bold", size = 4.5)
}

ggsave(paste0(dir_cross, "/Figure_Procrustes_Tripartite.png"), plot = plot_procrustes, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave(paste0(dir_cross, "/Figure_Procrustes_Tripartite.tiff"), plot = plot_procrustes, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 500, compression = "lzw")

UMBRAL_GENUS      <- 1 
medias_genus      <- colMeans(matriz_genus)
top_genus_names   <- names(medias_genus[medias_genus > UMBRAL_GENUS])
TOP_RES           <- 50
top_res_names     <- names(sort(colMeans(matriz_res), decreasing = TRUE)[1:TOP_RES])

mat_genus_top     <- matriz_genus[, top_genus_names, drop = FALSE]
mat_res_top       <- matriz_res[, top_res_names, drop = FALSE]

tabla_coocurrencia <- data.frame()
for (genus in top_genus_names) {
  for (gen in top_res_names) {
    if (sd(mat_genus_top[, genus]) > 0 & sd(mat_res_top[, gen]) > 0) {
      test <- cor.test(mat_genus_top[, genus], mat_res_top[, gen], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
      tabla_coocurrencia <- rbind(tabla_coocurrencia, data.frame(Genus = genus, ARG = gen, rho = test$estimate, p_val = test$p.value))
    }
  }
}

tabla_coocurrencia$p_adj <- p.adjust(tabla_coocurrencia$p_val, method = "BH")
tabla_significativa <- tabla_coocurrencia %>% 
  mutate(Significance = case_when(p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***", p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**", p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ ""))

write.csv(tabla_significativa %>% arrange(p_adj), paste0(dir_cross, "/Table_Genus_ARG_Correlations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

args_unicos <- unique(tabla_significativa$ARG)
labels_x    <- setNames(lapply(args_unicos, function(x) bquote(italic(.(x)))), args_unicos)

genus_unicos <- unique(tabla_significativa$Genus)
labels_y     <- setNames(lapply(genus_unicos, function(x) {
  if (grepl("sp\\. NEB 394", x)) {
    parte_genero <- sub(" sp\\. NEB 394.*", "", x)
    bquote(italic(.(parte_genero)) ~ "sp. NEB 394")
  } else {
    bquote(italic(.(x)))
  }
}), genus_unicos)

plot_cross_heatmap <- ggplot(tabla_significativa, aes(x = ARG, y = Genus, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Significance), color = "black", size = 3, vjust = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#4575B4", mid = "white", high = "#D73027", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Spearman's \nrho") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = labels_x) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = labels_y) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black", size = 8), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),                        
    axis.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), 
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Co-occurrence: Core Genera vs Core Antimicrobial Resistance Genes", subtitle = "* FDR p < 0.05, ** FDR p < 0.01, *** FDR p < 0.001")

ggsave(paste0(dir_cross, "/Figure_Heatmap_Genus_vs_ARG.png"), plot = plot_cross_heatmap, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave(paste0(dir_cross, "/Figure_Heatmap_Genus_vs_ARG.tiff"), plot = plot_cross_heatmap, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 500, compression = "lzw")
```

## Species-Level Cross-Analysis and Co-occurrence Heatmap

```{r species-cross-analysis, eval=FALSE}
setwd("/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/RESISTOMAvsABUNDANCIAvsAMBIENTE/SPECIES/31_MUESTRAS")
dir_cross_sp <- "results_CrossAnalysis"
if (!dir.exists(dir_cross_sp)) dir.create(dir_cross_sp)

tabla_species <- read.csv("Abundancia_Relativa_31_Species.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
muestras_species_res <- intersect(colnames(tabla_species), rownames(tabla_res))
muestras_comunes_sp  <- sort(intersect(muestras_species_res, metadatos_stats$Sample))

matriz_species <- as.matrix(t(tabla_species[, muestras_comunes_sp]))
matriz_res_sp  <- as.matrix(tabla_res[muestras_comunes_sp, ])
meta_limpio_sp <- metadatos_stats %>% filter(Sample %in% muestras_comunes_sp) %>% arrange(Sample) %>% rename(`Sample name` = Sample)

dist_species <- vegdist(matriz_species, method = "bray")
dist_res_sp  <- vegdist(matriz_res_sp, method = "bray")

set.seed(123)
mantel_simple_sp  <- mantel(dist_species, dist_res_sp, method = "spearman", permutations = 999)
set.seed(123)
mantel_parcial_sp <- mantel.partial(dist_species, dist_res_sp, dist_env, method = "spearman", permutations = 999)

pcoa_species <- cmdscale(dist_species, k = 2)
pcoa_res_sp  <- cmdscale(dist_res_sp, k = 2)

set.seed(123)
procrustes_res_sp <- protest(X = pcoa_species, Y = pcoa_res_sp, permutations = 999)

set.seed(123)
envfit_cross_sp <- envfit(pcoa_species, meta_limpio_sp %>% select(any_of(variables_continuas)), permutations = 999, na.rm = TRUE)
df_vectores_sp  <- as.data.frame(envfit_cross_sp$vectors$arrows) %>% cbind(p_val = envfit_cross_sp$vectors$pvals) %>% rownames_to_column("Variable") %>% filter(p_val < 0.05)

pro_data_sp <- data.frame(
  `Sample name` = rownames(matriz_species),
  Species_Dim1 = procrustes_res_sp$X[, 1], Species_Dim2 = procrustes_res_sp$X[, 2],
  Res_Dim1 = procrustes_res_sp$Yrot[, 1], Res_Dim2 = procrustes_res_sp$Yrot[, 2],
  check.names = FALSE
) %>% left_join(meta_limpio_sp, by = "Sample name")

plot_procrustes_sp <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = pro_data_sp, aes(x = Species_Dim1, y = Species_Dim2, xend = Res_Dim1, yend = Res_Dim2), color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = pro_data_sp, aes(x = Species_Dim1, y = Species_Dim2, fill = "Species"), shape = 21, size = 3) +
  geom_point(data = pro_data_sp, aes(x = Res_Dim1, y = Res_Dim2, fill = "Resistome"), shape = 21, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Species" = "#2166AC", "Resistome" = "#B2182B"), name = "Matrix") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Tripartite Procrustes: Species, Resistome & Environment",
    subtitle = sprintf("Procrustes Corr = %.3f | Partial Mantel r = %.3f", procrustes_res_sp$t0, mantel_parcial_sp$statistic),
    x = "Dimension 1", y = "Dimension 2"
  )

if (nrow(df_vectores_sp) > 0) {
  plot_procrustes_sp <- plot_procrustes_sp +
    geom_segment(data = df_vectores_sp, aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = Dim1 * escala, yend = Dim2 * escala), arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), color = "forestgreen", linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = df_vectores_sp, aes(x = Dim1 * escala, y = Dim2 * escala, label = Variable), color = "forestgreen", fontface = "bold", size = 4.5)
}

ggsave(paste0(dir_cross_sp, "/Figure_Procrustes_Tripartite_Species.png"), plot = plot_procrustes_sp, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave(paste0(dir_cross_sp, "/Figure_Procrustes_Tripartite_Species.tiff"), plot = plot_procrustes_sp, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 500, compression = "lzw")

UMBRAL_SPECIES     <- 1 
medias_species     <- colMeans(matriz_species)
top_species_names  <- names(medias_species[medias_species > UMBRAL_SPECIES])
mat_species_top    <- matriz_species[, top_species_names, drop = FALSE]

tabla_coocurrencia_sp <- data.frame()
for (species in top_species_names) {
  for (gen in top_res_names) {
    if (sd(mat_species_top[, species]) > 0 & sd(mat_res_top[, gen]) > 0) {
      test <- cor.test(mat_species_top[, species], mat_res_top[, gen], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
      tabla_coocurrencia_sp <- rbind(tabla_coocurrencia_sp, data.frame(Species = species, ARG = gen, rho = test$estimate, p_val = test$p.value))
    }
  }
}

tabla_coocurrencia_sp$p_adj <- p.adjust(tabla_coocurrencia_sp$p_val, method = "BH")
tabla_significativa_sp <- tabla_coocurrencia_sp %>% 
  mutate(Significance = case_when(p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***", p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**", p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ ""))

write.csv(tabla_significativa_sp %>% arrange(p_adj), paste0(dir_cross_sp, "/Table_Species_ARG_Correlations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

species_unicas <- unique(tabla_significativa_sp$Species)
labels_y_sp    <- setNames(lapply(species_unicas, function(x) {
  if (grepl("sp\\. NEB 394", x)) {
    parte_genero <- sub(" sp\\. NEB 394.*", "", x)
    bquote(italic(.(parte_genero)) ~ "sp. NEB 394")
  } else {
    bquote(italic(.(x)))
  }
}), species_unicas)

plot_cross_heatmap_sp <- ggplot(tabla_significativa_sp, aes(x = ARG, y = Species, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Significance), color = "black", size = 3, vjust = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#4575B4", mid = "white", high = "#D73027", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Spearman's \nrho") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = labels_x) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = labels_y_sp) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black", size = 8), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),                        
    axis.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), 
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Co-occurrence: Core Species vs Core Antimicrobial Resistance Genes", subtitle = "* FDR p < 0.05, ** FDR p < 0.01, *** FDR p < 0.001")

ggsave(paste0(dir_cross_sp, "/Figure_Heatmap_Species_vs_ARG.png"), plot = plot_cross_heatmap_sp, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave(paste0(dir_cross_sp, "/Figure_Heatmap_Species_vs_ARG.tiff"), plot = plot_cross_heatmap_sp, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 500, compression = "lzw")
```

## Consolidation of Master ARG Correlation Tables (Genus & Species)

```{r consolidate-arg-correlations, eval=FALSE}
dir_tablas <- "/Scratch/nemerita/proyectos/projectswaters/RESISTOMAvsABUNDANCIAvsAMBIENTE"
setwd(dir_tablas)

archivos_csv <- list.files(pattern = ".*ARG.*\\.csv$")

lista_tablas <- lapply(archivos_csv, function(archivo) {
  df <- read.csv(archivo, check.names = FALSE)
  df$Taxonomic_Level <- ifelse(grepl("Species", archivo), "Species", "Genus")
  return(df)
})

tabla_consolidada <- bind_rows(lista_tablas) %>%
  select(Taxonomic_Level, everything())

write.csv(tabla_consolidada, "Table_Consolidated_Master_ARG_Correlations.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
